summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing that on September 21, 2026 it and Accretiv Investment Holdings Inc. terminated and released a $1.5 million secured bridge promissory note and related security agreement, both dated September 2, 2026. No principal was ever advanced, no funding date occurred, the $75,000 lender return was not earned, and no default exists. The lender released all liens and both parties granted mutual releases. This is a routine terminated financing arrangement, not a special situation; there are no deal terms, premiums, or close dates to monitor.
